title: VTC Elections — Close — payload
description: An administrator closes voting in an election early, where its manifest allows it; the community has the ballot box close the board. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why voting is closed early, for the community's audit trail and its members.

Response.title: VTC Elections — Close — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/elections/close/0.1: the election's state once the ballot box closed it.

state.description: `closed`, or `tallied` where the ballot box tallied in the same step.
